notes.title: New Update: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Another update to fix some bugs!
Thanks to people commenting on the discussions on the Steam page, I was able to see a bug that happened when you got the ball behind the enemy in the Pong level, and had the Strong Blocks powerdown. The game would freeze and not be able to play anymore.
You guys are awesome! Thanks for letting me know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35693360/1f389eec343f7ea762fc8db6a712423d7ae7b7ff.gif[/img]

Sorry for the inconvenience, I hope this patch fixes it 100% for everybody! :)
If there's anything else, just talk to me! :)

Thanks!
Dan Zaidan

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
Hello!

I am super happy with the reviews so far!
It's awesome that you are enjoying the game as well! :)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35693360/15c9af1a28a718799e8b00f4af164e7ff211d9f0.png[/img]

Following some of your suggestions, I did an update for the game.

[b]Here is what I changed:[/b]
* Better sound effect when the comet starts
* Faster moving Power blocks
* Larger Power blocks
* More evident Power block animation

I hope you like it!

Remember that the game is 100% open-source!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155530/Source_Code__Break_Arcade_Games_Out/

You can also watch the ENTIRE development!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL7Ej6SUky1357r-Lqf_nogZWHssXP-hvH

[previewyoutube=cTwh9oHcs1w;full][/previewyoutube]

See you next time! ;)
